blocks.title: Project timeline
blocks.text: Setting project timelines means deciding how long each part of the project will take. This keeps the project on track and helps it finish on time.

blocks.title: Example
blocks.text: If you are building a website, you might set one timeline for designing the site, another for writing the content and another for testing everything.

blocks.prompt: How does a timeline help a project?
blocks.explanation: By fixing how long each part should take, it shows early whether the project is falling behind, so the team can act and still finish on time.

items: Timelines: how long each part takes; keep the project on track and on time (website: design, content, testing).
